paragraph: The Granville Composite issues a neutral primary verdict of 50/100, restricted by an active breadth divergence warning that caps the system at 60 because S&P 500 strength is unconfirmed by the weakening RSP/SPY breadth ratio. Market internals reveal critical structural drag as bellwether semiconductors drop sharply (SOXX/SPY at -1.41%), offsetting a bullish VIX signal (+1.41%) and mild risk-appetite expansion (SPHB/SPLV at +0.47%). Macro indicators provide superficial calm via a low VIX of 15.11 in steep contango, back-loaded skew at -7.8 points, and stable high-yield credit spreads at 2.70%. However, persistent small-cap underperformance at a 0.3876 ratio, combined with firm 10-year real yields at 2.43% and rising breakeven inflation at 2.26%, underscores a fragile, top-heavy advance. Given the capped composite score and clear semiconductor leadership failure, lean cautiously bearish for the session with a preference for fading unconfirmed intraday pops.
